title: OpenBikeComputer map catalog
description: The manifest of pre-baked .obcm maps: what exists, what it covers, what it was built from, and which OBCM format version it is. `obcm_version` is read from each artifact's own header, so a consumer can refuse a map the target firmware cannot read before downloading it. Normative contract: OBCC_Spec.md.

schema_version.description: Manifest envelope version. A consumer that does not recognise it rejects the entire document rather than reading the fields it happens to understand.

generated_at.description: When this manifest was generated, RFC 3339 UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).

presets.description: The presets artifacts were built with, sorted by `id`. Display order is the consumer's business, not the manifest's.

artifacts.description: Every published artifact, sorted by `(region_id, preset_id)`.

PresetEntry.description: One style preset offered to the user.

id.description: Stable preset id, e.g. `default`. Matches `preset_id` on artifacts.

description.description: One-line description of what this preset draws.

version.description: Preset content version — bumped whenever the preset's styling changes, so a consumer can tell "same preset, restyled" from "same bytes".

preview.description: Optional reference to a rendered preview asset, resolved against the same base URL as `url` on artifacts. Absent until the preview exists.

ArtifactEntry.description: One published `.obcm` artifact: a (region, preset) pair.

region_id.description: Slash-separated region id mirroring the Geofabrik hierarchy, e.g. `europe/switzerland`. Derived from the artifact's directory path.

preset_id.description: The preset this artifact was built with; matches a `presets[].id`.

preset_version.description: The preset's `version` at build time. Equal to the matching `presets[].version` for a coherent tree; a mismatch means the preset moved without a re-bake.

obcm_version.description: OBCM format version, read from the artifact's own header — never from the builder's intent. A consumer MUST refuse an artifact whose version the target firmware cannot read (`OBCC_Spec.md` §6).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes.

bbox.description: Coverage bbox, copied from the artifact header. Descriptive output, never a build input — see [`CoverageBBox`].

built_at.description: When the artifact was packed, RFC 3339 UTC.

source_snapshot.description: Date of the OSM extract it was packed from, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

url.description: Absolute or root-relative URL the artifact can be fetched from.

CoverageBBox.description: What the packed artifact actually covers, in integer microdegrees, copied from its OBCM header. Always a little wider than the extract box it was cut from (complete ways, stray coastline). Descriptive output only: it MUST NOT be fed back as a packer input bbox — see OBCC_Spec.md §4.
